releases.name: Wacky Rotations 1.0.0
releases.body:
-Fixed that bug about quaternion rotations not being unit length (I think).
-Massive setting overhaul, reorganized the setting page & added general settings.
releases.bodyZh:
- 修复了四元数旋转不是单位长度的错误（我认为）。
- 大规模设置重制，重新组织了设置页面并添加了通用设置。

releases.name: Wacky Rotations 0.1.0
releases.body: First release of Wacky Rotations. Kinda buggy, not too pretty, but it's fun!
releases.bodyZh: Wacky Rotations的首次发布。有点bug，不太好看，但很有趣！
